title: When Your Child Refuses Their Shoes | Parenting Rewind
description:
Your child refuses their shoes just when it is time to leave. This Parenting Rewind shows how a clear boundary and two acceptable choices can turn the moment into a simpler conversation.

General parenting education. Every child and family is different.

Source for the underlying positive-discipline principle: American Academy of Pediatrics — HealthyChildren.org, ‘What’s the Best Way to Discipline My Child?’
https://www.healthychildren.org/English/family-life/family-dynamics/communication-discipline/Pages/Disciplining-Your-Child.aspx
audience_intent: Adults and parents; not directed to children
